To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the domain plays an important role in opinion mining, that the use of domain-specific resources is crucial to achieve good results in this task, that domain-specific opinion mining systems are more accurate than generic approaches and that the size of the dataset used to build these resources has an impact on their quality.

(1) domain-specific opinion extraction systems are more accurate than domain-independent ones; (2) the size of the training set influences the quality of the extracted opinions; (3) the aggregation and visualization of extracted opinions is a useful task for businesses and consumers; (4) the domain of the dataset is a key factor in order to build a good opinion extraction system; and (5) our approach is useful to extract opinions in a specific domain.
